newsitem.title: UK: World OTC drug market seen continuing fast growth.
newsitem.headline: World OTC drug market seen continuing fast growth.

text.p: The market for over-the-counter (OTC) drugs is set to continue to grow rapidly as governments and insurers seek to transfer medicine costs directly to patients, management consultancy Datamonitor said on Monday.

In a report on the sector Datamonitor said that greater switching of prescription drugs to OTC use, which helps to extend patent life, and improved public understanding of self medication will also continue to drive growth.
The global OTC market is expanding at rates above 10 percent a year, rising in value to $46 billion in 1995 from $38 billion in 1993, Datamonitor said.
